name: Dromoka's Command
oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Prevent all damage target instant or sorcery spell would deal this turn.
• Target player sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
• Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
blocked_sentences: • Prevent all damage target instant or sorcery spell would deal this turn.

needs.what: a this-turn prevention op whose shield is keyed to a SPELL on the stack as the damage source (a `kind: spell` target with an instant/sorcery selector, `objects: {target: t1}`), preventing all damage that spell deals to any recipient (players, creatures, planeswalkers) for the rest of the turn, i.e. `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "by"` widened so its subject may be a stack object rather than only a battlefield permanent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "by"` and `duration: "this_turn"` has the right direction and clock, but it resolves `objects` battlefield-filtered and installs a `PermanentShield` on permanents only, so a targeted instant or sorcery on the stack gets no shield. `prevent_combat_damage` only touches combat damage, and `prevent_damage` (op) shields seats rather than a source. The other three modes (sacrifice with chooser, add_counters, fight) are expressible, but the card is not written partially.
